description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Battle of the Forces of Krishna and Bana, from a copy of the Dispersed Bhagavat Purana” by India Delhi-Agra region, possibly Mathura (c. 1520–1530), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 14849. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
